d: Anant sinh ke yahan shadi samaroh se jadyu ke tamam bare neta gayab hain. jabki dusri taraph bijepi aur rajad ke neta unke yahan ja rahe hain. lalan sinh aur ashok chaudhri jaise neta jo anant sinh ke behad karib hain vo is shadi samaroh se duri banate dikh rahe hain. kya jadyu aalakman ne apne netaon ko is shadi se dur rahne ke lie pharman jari kiya hai. aakhir iske pichhe ki kya vajah hai, is vidiyo men janie...
